items.quote: we are maintaining a similar range of 19% to 21%
items.statement: EBITDA margin of 19-21% for the coming year (FY27) and as a long-term range
items.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

items.quote: that is unlikely to be maintained going forward
items.statement: Current elevated EBITDA margin of about 22% not expected to be sustained
items.speaker: Deepanjan Bandyopadhyay

items.quote: we should still be targeting that double-digit growth
items.statement: Aspiration to return to double-digit revenue growth, no timeline given
items.speaker: Karthik Yathindra

tone.label: mixed
tone.why: Management is confident the recovery is steady and double-digit growth remains the target, but says it is difficult to put a timeline on it (p8-43-1, p14-86-1).
